facts: Standard DevEx rate of 0.0038 USD per eligible Earned Robux (114 USD per 30,000).
Higher 0.0054 USD per Robux rate for certain Earned Robux from verified U.S. 18+ player spending.
Legacy 0.0035 USD per Robux rate for balances earned before 5 September 2025 at 10:00 PT.
Minimum of 30,000 Earned Robux to participate.
Eligibility requirements: minimum age 13, Roblox-verified email address, valid DevEx portal account, IRS form W-9 or W-8 on file, compliance with the Roblox Terms of Use and Community Standards.
DevEx request handling, review, and payout process is operated solely by Roblox.
Supporting eligibility and account-standing context for the DevEx programme.
Marketplace avatar item sale: creator receives 30%, Roblox receives 70%.
Avatar item bought inside an experience: item creator 30%, experience owner 40%, Roblox 30%.
Progressive Marketplace revenue share by price-floor multiple: 1x=30%, 1.3x=37%, 1.5x=41%, 2x=50%, 2.5x=57%, 3x=62%, 3.5x=65%, 4x=67%, 5x=69%, 6x and above=70%.
Progressive revenue share applies only to Marketplace purchases; in-experience purchases use the base commission.
Creators receive 70% of Robux spent on in-experience purchases such as developer products and passes; Roblox retains 30%.
Earned Robux must be converted through the Developer Exchange programme to become real currency.
Euro foreign exchange reference rates used to derive USD cross rates for local-currency estimates.
Reference rates are published once per working day at approximately 16:00 CET and are not tradable bank quotes.
Scaled content abuse and doorway pages are policy violations, which is why numeric amount pages on this site are capped and manually approved.
Canonical URL guidance applied to calculator query-parameter states, which canonicalise to their clean owning route.
Next.js applications deploy to Cloudflare Workers through the OpenNext adapter with Workers Static Assets.

Required wrangler configuration: `.open-next/worker.js` entry, `.open-next/assets` static directory, `nodejs_compat` and `global_fetch_strictly_public` compatibility flags, and the WORKER_SELF_REFERENCE service binding.
`initOpenNextCloudflareForDev()` enables Cloudflare bindings during `next dev`.
Turnstile tokens must be validated server-side against the siteverify endpoint, and each token may be redeemed only once.
Cloudflare Workers Builds connects a GitHub repository to a Worker for automatic builds and deployments on push.

Revenue of 1,469 million USD for the three months ended 30 June 2026, and 1,081 million USD for the same period in 2025.
Developer exchange fees equal to 25 percent of revenue in Q2 2026 and 29 percent in Q2 2025.
Daily active users grew 10% year over year to 123 million for the three months ended 30 June 2026.
Hours engaged grew 5% year over year to 29 billion for the three months ended 30 June 2026.

standard-current.label: Standard rate
standard-current.eligibilitySummary: The standard DevEx rate applied to eligible Earned Robux. Roblox documents this as 0.0038 USD per Earned Robux, which is 114 USD for 30,000 Earned Robux.

us-18-plus-qualified.label: Eligible U.S. 18+ rate
us-18-plus-qualified.eligibilitySummary: A higher rate Roblox applies to certain Earned Robux from purchases of developer products, passes, subscriptions, and private servers made by United States players who have verified that they are at least 18 years old.
us-18-plus-qualified.conditionNote: This rate is not selectable by the creator. Roblox determines which portion of a balance qualifies. Do not assume a whole balance earns this rate.

legacy-pre-2025-09-05.label: Legacy balance rate
legacy-pre-2025-09-05.eligibilitySummary: The rate that applied before 5 September 2025 at 10:00 PT, equal to 105 USD for 30,000 Earned Robux. Roblox cashes out balances earned before that moment at this older rate first.
legacy-pre-2025-09-05.conditionNote: Applies only to the portion of a balance earned before the transition, under Roblox's own accounting. A creator cannot choose this rate.

minimum.note: Roblox states a minimum of 30,000 Earned Robux to submit a DevEx request. Meeting the number is not the same as being approved.

limits.note: These are application safety limits chosen by DevExCalculator.org to keep arithmetic and rendering bounded. They are not Roblox limits and must never be presented as such.

in-experience.label: In-experience purchase
in-experience.description: Developer products, passes, private servers and subscriptions bought inside an experience you own.

marketplace-avatar-item.label: Marketplace avatar item sale
marketplace-avatar-item.description: An avatar item sold through the Roblox Marketplace. The creator share rises with the item's price as a multiple of the price floor.

avatar-item-in-experience.label: Avatar item sold inside an experience
avatar-item-in-experience.description: An avatar item bought inside an experience. The item creator and the experience owner are paid separately.

currencies.note: Every currency below is published in the European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rate set. USD is the base of this calculator and is derived from the ECB USD/EUR series. A currency is listed here only if the configured provider actually publishes it daily. BGN was removed on 2026-08-17 because the ECB stopped publishing it after 2025-12-31; claiming support for a rate the provider no longer supplies would be dishonest.

developerExchangeFees.label: Developer exchange fees
developerExchangeFees.description: The money Roblox paid out through the Developer Exchange programme, as reported on its income statement.

derivation.q1-2025: Six months ended 30 June 2025 (598) minus Q2 2025 (316), both in millions.
derivation.q1-2026: Six months ended 30 June 2026 (786) minus Q2 2026 (363), both in millions.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.description: Roblox's reported revenue over the same periods, for scale.

shareOfRevenue.label: Developer exchange fees as a share of revenue
shareOfRevenue.description: Reported by Roblox as a percentage, not computed here.

companyContext.label: Roblox as a business
companyContext.description: Reported results for the three months ended 30 June, for readers judging how solid the platform they earn from is.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.note: Up 36% year on year, as stated in the release.

devex-share-revenue.label: Developer exchange fees as a share of revenue
devex-share-revenue.note: Roughly a quarter of Roblox's revenue leaves again as creator payouts.

devex-share-bookings.label: Developer exchange fees as a share of bookings
devex-share-bookings.note: Measured against bookings rather than revenue.

bookings-growth.label: Bookings growth, year on year
bookings-growth.note: Described in the release as the low end of guidance.

net-loss.label: Consolidated net loss
net-loss.note: A smaller loss than the same quarter a year earlier.

adjusted-ebitda.label: Adjusted EBITDA
adjusted-ebitda.note: A non-GAAP measure Roblox defines in the same release.

free-cash-flow.label: Free cash flow
free-cash-flow.note: Up 66% year on year, as stated in the release.

engagement.label: Users and engagement
engagement.description: How many people use Roblox and how long they spend there, as Roblox reports it to the SEC.

daus.label: Daily active users
daus.note: An average of daily actives across the quarter, not a count of accounts that exist.

hours.label: Hours engaged in the quarter
hours.note: Total across every user for the three months ended 30 June 2026.

registrations.label: Total registered accounts
registrations.reason: Roblox reports daily and monthly actives, never a cumulative registration count. Any total circulating for it is someone's estimate, and this site does not publish estimates of other people's numbers.

session-length.label: Average session length
session-length.reason: Roblox publishes hours in aggregate, not sessions. Dividing hours by users gives time per user per day, which is on this page; turning that into a session length would require a session count nobody outside Roblox has.
